title: CSS Generator - public implementations survey
definition: Defines layouts, colors, spacing, and visual presentation.
description:
CSS Generator is one of the fundamental capabilities an AI needs to build things on demand: Defines layouts, colors, spacing, and visual presentation. In the real world this capability is delivered by a rich ecosystem of tools, libraries and platforms. This database is the public edition - a fact-checked survey of the real implementations, the real techniques they share, the standards they follow, and laddered drills that teach the capability hands-on.

Together they map the territory as it actually exists.

Every record carries a runnable demonstration program, because tools are understood by use. Run the demos with node, compare the implementations, practice the drills, and the CSS Generator capability becomes something you can reach for - with full knowledge of which real tool fits which job.
